{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders
df['is_qa'] = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)

# Check if any QA orders are in the target population (new + paid_search)
qa_in_target = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & df['is_qa']]

print(f"Number of QA orders in the target population (new + paid_search): {len(qa_in_target)}")
print(f"QA orders in target population: {qa_in_target[['order_id', 'revenue_clean', 'converted']]}")

# Check their converted status
qa_converted_count = qa_in_target['converted'].sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders in target population that converted: {qa_converted_count}")"}
